name: CHROMICUM ACIDUM
key_symptoms: Uneasiness in limbs. Pain in shoulder-blades and back of neck. Pain in knees and balls of feet. Drawing pain in soles while walking.

head_symptoms: Ulcer and scabs in nose. Offensive smell. Corrosive pain. Ozćna (Aur).
